title: गणतन्त्रपछिका समकालीन नेपाली कवितामा असन्तुष्टिका अभिव्यक्तिहरू
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक आलेख साहित्यको कविता विधासँग सम्बन्धित छ । यस आलेखमा वि.स. २०६५ साल जेठ १५ गते नेपालमा गणतन्त्र स्थापना भएपछिको समयमा लेखिएका र समकालीन चेतना भएका मलूतः फुटकर गद्य कविता र केही छन्दोबद्ध नेपाली कवितामा व्यक्त भएका विविध खाले असन्तुष्टिका अभिव्यक्तिहरूको खोजी र विश्लेषण गर्ने कार्य गरिएकोछ । यहाँ गणतन्त्र, समकालीन र समकालीनता, असन्तुिष्ट जस्ता शब्दहरूकोअर्थर आशय उल्लेख गर्दै विभिन्न खालका असन्तुिष्ट जस्तै, सामाजिक आथिर्क अभावजन्य असन्तुिष्ट, राजनीतिक अव्यव्स्थाजन्य असन्तुिष्ट, यौन असन्तुष्टि, सहरी समाजले सिर्जना गरेका असन्तुिष्ट, विदशेी हस्तक्षेपजन्य असन्तुिष्ट आदिलाई उपशीर्षकीकृत गरी विश्लष्ोण गरिएकोछ । साथै गणतन्त्रपछिका समकालीन नेपाली कविताको मूल प्रवृत्ति नै असन्तुष्टि हो भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present research article is related to the poetry genre of literature. In this article, the task of exploring and analyzing the diverse kinds of expressions of dissatisfaction voiced in mainly scattered prose poems and some metrical Nepali poems that were written in the period after the establishment of the republic in Nepal on Jestha 15, 2065 BS and that carry a contemporary consciousness has been carried out. Here, while mentioning the meaning and intent of words such as republic, contemporary and contemporaneity, dissatisfaction, various kinds of dissatisfaction, such as dissatisfaction born of social and economic deprivation, dissatisfaction born of political disarray, sexual dissatisfaction, dissatisfaction created by urban society, dissatisfaction born of foreign intervention and so on, have been analyzed by grouping them under subheadings. In addition, the conclusion has been drawn that the basic tendency of contemporary Nepali poetry after the republic is dissatisfaction itself.
british_english: The present research article is concerned with the poetry genre of literature. In this article, the work of investigating and analysing the varied expressions of dissatisfaction voiced in chiefly occasional prose poems and certain metrically composed Nepali poems written in the period following the establishment of the republic in Nepal on 15 Jestha 2065 BS, poems possessed of a contemporary awareness, has been undertaken. Here, setting out the meaning and purport of words such as republic, contemporary and contemporaneity, and dissatisfaction, various kinds of dissatisfaction, for instance dissatisfaction arising from social and economic want, dissatisfaction arising from political disorder, sexual dissatisfaction, dissatisfaction engendered by urban society, dissatisfaction arising from foreign intervention and the like, have been analysed under sub-headings. Moreover, the conclusion has been reached that the essential tendency of contemporary Nepali poetry after the republic is dissatisfaction itself.
australian_english: This research article has to do with the poetry genre in literature. In this article, the job of digging into and analysing the different sorts of dissatisfaction expressed in mainly scattered prose poems and a few metrical Nepali poems written in the period after the republic was set up in Nepal on Jestha 15, 2065 BS, poems with a contemporary awareness about them, has been carried out. Here, while noting the meaning and intent of words like republic, contemporary and contemporaneity, and dissatisfaction, all the different kinds of dissatisfaction, such as dissatisfaction coming out of social and economic hardship, dissatisfaction coming out of political mess, sexual dissatisfaction, dissatisfaction cooked up by city society, dissatisfaction coming out of foreign interference and so on, have been put under subheadings and analysed. On top of that, the conclusion has been drawn that the core tendency of contemporary Nepali poetry after the republic is dissatisfaction itself.
informal_english: This research piece is all about poetry. In it, the job was to dig out and pick apart the different kinds of dissatisfaction that show up in mostly scattered prose poems and a few metred Nepali poems written after the republic came in on Jestha 15, 2065 BS, poems with a bit of contemporary awareness about them. Here, after explaining what words like republic, contemporary, contemporaneity and dissatisfaction actually mean, the various sorts of dissatisfaction, the kind that comes from social and economic hardship, the kind from political mess, sexual dissatisfaction, the dissatisfaction the city creates, the dissatisfaction that comes from foreign meddling and so on, were all sorted under subheadings and analysed. And on top of that, the conclusion drawn is that the whole basic tendency of contemporary Nepali poetry after the republic is dissatisfaction itself, no less.
